sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B AEON Uncensored: How This Abliteration Actually Works
sources.snippet: What is Qwen3.8-27B-AEON-ULTIMATE-UNCENSORED-BF16? It's a community-modified, full-precision (BF16) release built on Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B, with the internal refusal behavior removed through a process called abliteration.
